question.text: A Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) under PMLA must be filed within:

explanation.text: The Logic: PMLA: STR must be filed to FIU-IND within 7 working days of suspicion forming. The Trap: 24 hours is too tight; 30 days / quarterly too lax. Cross-Exam Context: XXIV and III-A test. Manager's Pro-Tip: STR suspicion is subjective — document the reasoning trail to defend the filing (or the non-filing) in case of FIU scrutiny.
